summary: WidePoint Corporation filed an 8-K to reschedule its 2026 Annual Meeting from June 19, 2026 to June 17, 2026 for administrative reasons. The filing provides details on proxy voting by telephone, internet, or online at the virtual meeting. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. This is purely an administrative schedule change. The meeting reminder and proxy instructions are routine, not a special situation.
